title: sitian promoted to Moderator
summary: Congrats to SLOA | itz_sitian on the promotion from Helper to Moderator, plus some behind-the-scenes fixes to farm links and ticket automation.
description: Staff promotion, migration from @ArchiverBot to @mihulish, reworked /dn links, fixed DN 529, and stopped duplicate ticket pings.

body.text: Big congrats to SLOA | itz_sitian, who moved from Helper to Moderator.
Moved from @ArchiverBot to @mihulish after ArchiverBot stopped working, and rebuilt archiver functionality as best we could.
/dn links no longer redirect to a website. Instead, you now get 1-3 buttons to choose from.
Repaired the bugged DN: 529 video link.
Fixed double/mass ping in tickets from @mihulish — the bot was resetting its own 24h cycle and going a bit rogue.
